name: Signal Box
summary: A train switching puzzle on a glowing junction diagram: throw the points so each train reaches its platform
about: A night-shift signal box with a track diagram that draws itself, a tunnel portal with a blinking lamp, numbered junctions, colour-coded platforms named after Pakistani towns, a departures list and a lever frame whose levers swing when you throw them. Trains roll out of the tunnel with a dotted line that shows where the current points will send them, and a warning mark when that is the wrong platform. Each shift adds a platform and faster trains; three wrong platforms end the game.
how: A demo shift plays on load; press Take the levers, Start shift, a number key or click the diagram to take over.
Click a junction on the diagram, press its number key or pull its lever to switch it between up and down.
Follow each train's dotted route and its colour: it must reach the platform with the same colour and letter.
Junctions lock while a train is on the points; Space sends the next train early for a quicker shift.
On-time runs raise the multiplier, a perfect shift earns 500 bonus and three wrong platforms end the game; P pauses and R restarts.
Your best score is saved on this device and reduced motion turns off the smoke and shaking.
